programs.title: I Died... And Came Back
programs.desc: A man is admitted to the hospital for a kidney stone but gets more than he bargained for; his near-death experience takes him outside his body and on an unexpected journey; a woman's visit to the 8th wonder of the world leads to her NDE and a physical and spiritual journey.

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: In Russia, 34,000-year-old graves are discovered; a team attempts to locate a World War II British airplane that went missing in Iceland; tiny fossils in an Alaskan riverbank; a massive, previously undiscovered depression in the ice in Antarctica.

programs.title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
programs.desc: Hidden in plain sight are astronomic marvels able to rip space and time to shreds; what's theoretical becomes the reality with the first black hole image, but much remains unknown; how do black holes form and do they create galaxies?

programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: The boys head out to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Rideau Canal and explore the waters around one of the last hand-operated locks in North America.

programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: The banks of the Thames River in Ontario were the site of the battle won by Americans at Moraviantown during the War of 1812. After more than 11,000 years of human settlement, these banks may have more than just secrets.

programs.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programs.desc: Runes are the letters of an ancient Germanic writing system that harkens back to a mythological age filled with heroes, magic, and mystery.
